question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The city’s infrastructure was ill-equipped to handle the influx of ________(visitors) during the peak season.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"visitors"** means people who visit a place for pleasure, business, or any other purpose. (आगंतुक)

 
 
• **Example: **The museum had many visitors during the holidays.
 
 
 
• **"Tourists"** refers to people who travel to a place for pleasure. (पर्यटक)
 
 
• **Example: **Many tourists visit Paris to see the Eiffel Tower.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Natives** (मूल निवासी): People who were born in a particular place.

 
 
• **Example:** The natives of the island have a rich cultural heritage.
 
 
 
• **Citizens** (नागरिक): Legally recognized subjects or nationals of a state.
 
 
• **Example:** All citizens have the right to vote.
 
 
 
• **Residents** (निवासी): People who live in a particular place.
 
 
• **Example:** The residents of the apartment complex organized a community event.
